prompt:
Generate a high fidelity OmniGear DPI configuration UI mockup, inheriting the attached approved Botões screen's EXACT visual identity, header, sidebar, font voice, neutral monochrome palette, and footer, but REPLACE the mouse remapping content with a practical DPI editor. Reference carries chrome and visual identity ONLY: do not copy the mouse, callouts or remapping editor. Output a square comparison board: two equally sized complete desktop landscape app screens stacked vertically, DARK above and LIGHT below. Identical layout and content in both themes. No outer title or browser frame. Large crisp Portuguese text.
Header: 'OmniGear', 'Demonstração' badge, ONE moon outline icon at top right in dark viewport, ONE sun outline icon at top right in light viewport. No switch, no simultaneous sun/moon, no Claro/Escuro labels. Sidebar about20% width: '← Dispositivos', 'Mouse de demonstração', 'Perfil 1' dropdown; navigation 'Botões', 'DPI' selected, 'Desempenho', 'Parâmetros', 'Perfis', 'Geral'. Main heading 'DPI', subtitle 'Ajuste a sensibilidade do mouse.' Header action '+ Adicionar estágio'.
Show four demo DPI stages with values: Estágio 1 = 400, Estágio 2 = 800, Estágio 3 = 1600, Estágio 4 = 3200. Estágio2 is currently active; communicate 'Ativo' using text + small check, not color alone. Each editable numeric field clearly labeled DPI and paired with a slim horizontal range slider. No invented hardware specifications, no RGB, no colored accents. Show capability control 'Eixos X/Y independentes' with UNCHECKED checkbox (this is a settings checkbox, not a theme toggle), plus concise helper 'Use a mesma sensibilidade nos dois eixos.' Use clean stroke icons, strong body contrast.
Main bottom sticky footer: left '1 alteração não salva', right secondary 'Descartar', primary 'Salvar no perfil'. Same footer as reference. White primary on dark, black primary on light. Spacious working app interface with controls prominent and realistic density.
Main structure: 2 by 2 grid of four substantial stage panels below heading. Each panel contains heading Estágio N; for stage2 small Ativo text badge, editable numeric DPI field, long horizontal slider, bottom 'Tornar ativo' (except active stage2) and subtle trash icon with 'Remover'. Stage2 distinguished with stronger thin border. Panels contain ONLY these real controls, not nested cards. One flat checkbox/helper row for independent axes below the grid. Grid is primary content; no mouse image or decorative graphics. Good generous padding.
title: Estágios em grade
description: Quatro estágios visíveis, com ajuste direto em cada bloco.
notes: Composition proposal. Values and slider limits are illustrative demo content. Implementation must use device capabilities and mathematically correct slider positions.
